faq.title: SafeTools Image Studio FAQ
faq.desc: Everything you need to know about our privacy-first image processing ecosystem.
faq.q1: Are my images uploaded to any server?
faq.a1: Absolutely not. SafeTools uses WebAssembly (WASM) and local GPU acceleration to process images directly on your device. Your data never leaves your browser.
faq.a2: Our studio supports JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, SVG, GIF, HEIC, TIFF, and even PDF-to-image conversions. Most tools support bulk batch processing.
